20 Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me. (Revelation 3:20 KJV)

This is a beautiful picture of what happens at salvation, when someone accepts Jesus and gets born again. Jesus doesn’t just stay for supper, but He moves in and stays in our hearts forever, and will never leave us or forsake us (Hebrews 13:5). Wow! That is so awesome, that Christ lives inside us, who are born again, in the spirit (Galatians 4:6), and we can tap into the very power of the full Godhead, that lives within us, when we put the Word of God into our hearts and renew our minds to all the truths that it contains (Romans 12:2).

This actually is written to Christians, and is telling them to come back to Jesus, as they had fallen away from walking close to Him. You can’t lose your salvation and get it back (Hebrews 6:4-6), but you can certainly quit walking in the spirit and doing the will of God. Why anyone who has experienced the peace and joy of being close to God, would fall away from serving Him, is hard for me to understand, as serving and being full of the love of God, who is love (1 John 4:8), is the most wonderful thing that has ever happened to me. Nothing can compare to the peace and joy He gives His servants, as well as all the rest of the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). Thank you Lord for all our gifts.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
